disclaimer: Illustrative checklist for prototype evaluation; does not constitute legal title clearance or statutory legal advice under Maharashtra state laws.

items.name: Property Card (7/12 or City Survey Extract)
items.description: Extract of City Survey or 7/12 proving current registered title and ownership history.

items.name: Registered Sale / Conveyance Deed
items.description: Registered deed transferring title to the current owner/issuer.

items.name: Index II (Registration Summary)
items.description: Official receipt and summary issued post-registration by the Sub-Registrar.

items.name: Encumbrance Search Report (13-30 Years)
items.description: Search certificate confirming property is free of registered encumbrances, charges, or liens.

items.name: Approved Building & Sanction Plans
items.description: Town planning sanction and building approval drawings.

items.name: Occupancy Certificate (OC)
items.description: Certificate from competent municipal planning authority confirming building is fit for occupation.

items.name: Latest Property Tax Assessment & Paid Receipt
items.description: Proof of municipal tax clearance for the current assessment period.

items.name: Independent Valuation Report (IBBI Registered)
items.description: Appraisal report determining current market valuation and net capitalization rates.

items.name: Registered Lease / Rent Roll Evidence
items.description: Commercial tenancy agreement or rent roll confirming tenant occupancy and rental cash flows.
